title: Clean a messy CSV and save an aggregation
goal: Write clean_sales.py, run as `python clean_sales.py <input.csv> <output.csv>`. The input has the columns date,region,amount (see data/sales.csv). Cleaning rules: trim whitespace around every value; region is case-insensitive and is written in Title Case; amount may use a decimal comma (12,50), a euro sign and spaces, also as a thousands separator ("€ 7.00", "1 000,00"); a row whose amount is empty or not a number is skipped; rows that are exactly the same after cleaning count once. The output has the header region,total,count -- one row per region, sorted by region name, total with exactly 2 decimals. Then run it on data/sales.csv and commit the result as out/by_region.csv. Standard library only. Do not change data/, expected/ or check_output.py.
verify: python clean_sales.py data/sales.csv out/check.csv && python check_output.py out/check.csv expected/by_region.csv && python check_output.py out/by_region.csv expected/by_region.csv
